summary: Revised implementation plan for AutoTrust incorporating all user modifications: plain JavaScript (JSX) with React Router routes (/, /services, /contact), single-sheet checkout (pickup/drop-off, time slot, Confirm with 'Pay after service' only), price lock activated upon booking confirmation, pricing based on vehicle category and fuel type, clear 'demo' indicators on sample content, interactive 'Demo: next stage' and 'Add extra-work request' buttons in the live tracking panel, photo placeholders, and responsive Desktop/Mobile preview toggle.
